# Make Your Week Last

> An independent guide for Grok Bot users on The X Subscription who run out of weekly usage. Not affiliated with SpaceXSI, xAI, X or Cursor.

Key facts (with official sources):
- Each paid seat on The X Subscription gets one weekly pool shared across eligible Grok and Cursor surfaces, not separate product quotas: https://docs.x.ai/x-subscription/usage-limits
- Grok Bot has no separate meter; check usage and the next reset date under Usage at grok.com/dashboard: https://cursor.com/help/grok-bot/plans
- Every routine run spends usage. An hourly schedule, a short interval, or a Slack trigger on a busy channel can use a week of usage in a day. Test runs also spend usage: https://cursor.com/help/grok-bot/routines
- Past the pool, usage is paid Additional Usage from prepaid credit. Controls (monthly additional usage limit, Auto Top-up, which is off unless you turn it on) are under Additional usage credits on Billing & invoices at grok.com/dashboard/billing: https://docs.x.ai/x-subscription/prepaid-balance

## Pages
- [Grok Bot weekly usage running out? 8 fixes that work](https://botfixer5000.github.io/make-your-week-last/grok-bot-weekly-usage-running-out/): why the shared pool drains, how to cap surprise charges, routine runs-per-week math, and 8 fixes
- [Grok Bot routine didn't run? A 7-point checklist](https://botfixer5000.github.io/make-your-week-last/grok-bot-routine-not-running/): paused routines, schedule and time zone, new routines waiting for their first time, trigger matching, disconnected apps, run history, and platform-side outages (missed runs are not replayed)
- ["Automation run rate limit exceeded" in Grok Bot](https://botfixer5000.github.io/make-your-week-last/automation-run-rate-limit-exceeded/): the 300/hour total and 200/hour per-routine limits, the known shared platform limit, and how to retry webhook calls
- [Which plan includes Grok Bot?](https://botfixer5000.github.io/make-your-week-last/which-plan-includes-grok-bot/): Grok Bot is on Premium ($30), Super ($100) and Ultra ($200) of The X Subscription, not Plus or Free (list prices, Oct 2026); one shared weekly pool; legacy Cursor and SuperGrok options
- [Grok Bot routine triggers explained](https://botfixer5000.github.io/make-your-week-last/grok-bot-routine-triggers/): schedule, Slack, email to the bot's mail.grokbot.com address, GitHub/Linear/Sentry/PagerDuty events, and webhooks, ranked by how many runs they tend to create
- [Make Your Week Last kit](https://botfixer5000.github.io/make-your-week-last/): $12 PDF + 5 templates (Usage Log, Lean Rules, read-only monthly Routine Audit skill that plugs into the Usage Log, quiet-routine pattern, Plan Picker). Buy: https://botfixer5000.gumroad.com/l/make-your-week-last
